summary: All issue #80 acceptance criteria are proven by code in the diff plus model-free tests. The diff introduces only the independent superagent-storage crate (5-table SQLite schema, exclusive run lease, transactional intent persist-then-bind, injectable breakpoints, monotonic event sequence, bounded summaries, artifact references) and evidence files. No codex-rs core files are touched, no codex-* dependencies or codex_ symbols are added, no process/model execution is present, and no secrets are committed. The provided test log (16 passed) is internally consistent with the 16 #[test] functions in the diff. Two minor, non-blocking observations are recorded; neither weakens the acceptance criteria.

findings.detail: BeforeExternalBind fires before the bind transaction opens and BeforeEventAppend fires before the INSERT is issued, rather than immediately before their commits. The observable post-fault state matches the acceptance (intent left unbound; event not appended) and is covered by tests, so #80 is unaffected; the crate/doc comment wording 'commit boundary' slightly overstates the exact hook position. #84 can still inject the required faults between persist and bind.

Duplicate rejection surfaces as a raw StoreError::Sqlite constraint violation rather than a dedicated typed duplicate error. Rejection behavior is correct and the required tests exist, so this is a readability/API-precision note only.
